'''''Juncus bulbosus''''', the '''bulbous rush''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Juncaceae]], native to Iceland, the Faroes, Europe, [[Macaronesia]], and northwest Africa.<ref name="324840-2" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:324840-2 |title=''Juncus bulbosus'' L. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=19 January 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Juncus bulbosus'' bulbous rush |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/9514/Juncus-bulbosus/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=19 January 2021 |quote=Other common names; … lesser jointed rush }}</ref> It has been introduced to Australia, New Zealand, and some locations in northern North America.<ref name="324840-2" /> It is capable of nuisance growth in lakes and streams.<ref name="1_of_3620_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=''Juncus bulbosus'' nuisance growth in oligotrophic freshwater ecosystems: Different triggers for the same phenomenon in rivers and lakes? |year=2013 |last1=Schneider |first1=Susanne C. |last2=Fosholt Moe |first2=Therese |last3=Hessen |first3=Dag O. |last4=Kaste |first4=Øyvind |journal=Aquatic Botany |volume=104 |pages=15–24 |doi=10.1016/j.aquabot.2012.10.001 |bibcode=2013AqBot.104...15S |hdl=10852/70876 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>
